correctness.rationale: At stationarity, fresh N(0,sigma²) Poisson redraws preserve the Gaussian one-time velocity distribution; two velocities are correlated only if their interval has no collision, so covariance is sigma² exp[-(gamma+r)|t-s|]. For ordered four-time gaps a,b,c, conditional Gaussian block pairings yield cumulant 2 sigma⁴ exp[-lambda(a+2b+c)](exp(rb)-1), lambda=gamma+r; checked independent enumeration of 8 collision-pattern configurations for two parameter sets. Integrating the connected cumulant over the ordered four-time simplex gives cum4(X_T)=48 sigma⁴∫_0^T exp[-2lambda b](exp(rb)-1)J_lambda(T-b)db>0; J_lambda(L)=∫_0^L q(L-q)exp(-lambda q)dq. Var X_T=sigma² B_lambda(T), B=2∫_0^T(T-h)e^-lambda h dh. The ratio B_lambda(T2)/B_lambda(T1) for 0<T1<T2 strictly decreases with lambda by monotone likelihood ratio of weighted lags; determines lambda, first variance determines sigma, strict monotonicity of positive cum4 integral at fixed lambda determines r, then gamma=lambda-r. Boundaries require gamma,r,sigma>0 and exact ensemble moments, not empirical finite sample certainty.
